verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a compatibility promise, versioning policy, or upgrade guides between Terraform releases. The only related item is one community anecdote (terraform-comm-1) that upgrades went smoothly, which is hands-on experience rather than a documented promise or guide. Release compatibility is a fair axis for an IaC tool, so the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on documented compatibility promises and upgrade guides between releases
